conventional_init_seconds.name: conventional_init_seconds
conventional_init_seconds.rationale: conventional (non-snapshot) NIM start time excluding artifact load I/O; only the MSA Search cached conventional route is measured

conventional_load_bytes_per_s.name: conventional_load_bytes_per_s
conventional_load_bytes_per_s.rationale: effective artifact ingest bandwidth during a conventional load

gpu_hour_usd.name: gpu_hour_usd
gpu_hour_usd.rationale: H100-class hourly price used for reserved GPU-hour cost

gpu_release_seconds.name: gpu_release_seconds
gpu_release_seconds.rationale: drain/teardown time to release the GPU from model A before starting model B; not yet measured as an isolated phase

l1_capacity_gib.name: l1_capacity_gib
l1_capacity_gib.rationale: node-local NVMe budget reserved for the L1 artifact cache

l2_egress_usd_per_gib.name: l2_egress_usd_per_gib
l2_egress_usd_per_gib.rationale: remote artifact read/egress cost per GiB fetched into L1

l2_fetch_bytes_per_s.name: l2_fetch_bytes_per_s
l2_fetch_bytes_per_s.rationale: remote artifact localization bandwidth per node; Phase 5 observed ~483 MB/s single-stream and ~2356 MB/s 4-way parallel NRD reads, but no task-scoped L2 benchmark exists for this fleet

node_mtbf_hours.name: node_mtbf_hours
node_mtbf_hours.rationale: preemptible node mean time between preemptions

node_reprovision_seconds.name: node_reprovision_seconds
node_reprovision_seconds.rationale: time from preemption to a replacement node Ready with empty caches

synthetic_scale_max.name: synthetic_scale_max
synthetic_scale_max.rationale: upper bound of per-model timing/size scale relative to its anchor

synthetic_scale_min.name: synthetic_scale_min
synthetic_scale_min.rationale: lower bound of per-model timing/size scale relative to its anchor; no catalog-wide measurement exists yet
